༄༅/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi mngon rtogs bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru rat+na warta ya/bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can ma lus

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi mngon rtogs bzhugs so// na mo gu ru rat+na warta ya/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can ma lus pa dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyis/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las rnams/ /gcig tu bsdus pa sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ba'i gnas/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun kun gyi mnga' bdag che/ /zhes pa'i mthar/ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen po'i skyabs su mchi/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin ston pa sangs rgyas la/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen po'i skyabs su mchi/ /lung rtogs bdag nyid ston pa dam chos la/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen po'i skyabs su mchi/ /rgyal sras bstan 'dzin 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen po'i skyabs su mchi/ /zhes ci nus brjod pa'i mthar/ bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog rin po che/ /rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /khyed kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab du gsol/ /bdag blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dam chos lam du longs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lam gyi 'khrul pa zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'khrul snang dbyings su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos min rnam rtog 'gag par byin gyis rlobs/ /byams dang snying rje 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /myur du rnam mkhyen thob par byin gyi rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba btab la/ ma gyur mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi/ /don du bla med byang chub thob par bya/ /de'i ched du sangs rgyas kun gyi lam/ /zab mo'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha/ sarba dharma swa bha wa shud+dha3 haṃ/

chos dbyings mtha' bral chen po'i ngang nyid las/ /dgos 'dod sna tshogs stsol ba'i rin chen khri/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos pad+ma'i gdan/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ste/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas kun dngos spyan ras gzigs/ /dri med dung dang chu shel lta bu'i mdog /shin tu yid 'ong 'dzum zhal zhi zhing sgeg /phyag bzhi'i dang po thugs kar thal mo sbyar/ /'og ma shel 'phreng nor bu pad+ma 'dzin/ /rab mdzes zhabs gnyis rdo rje dkyil krung bzhugs/ /yid 'phrog dar dang rin chen du mas spras/ /mthon mthing ral pa'i thor gtsug lcang los mdzes/ /gang de'i spyi bor sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /ye shes gcig bsdus skyabs gnas kun gyi gtso/ /ngo bo bla ma rnam pa 'od dpag med/ /rigs bdag tshul du dges shing bzhugs par gyur/ /rang nyid lha sku me long gzugs bzhin snang / /snang stong zung du 'jug pa sgyu ma'i gar/ /gar mkhan bzang ltar cha lugs du mas mdzes/ /mdzes shing yid 'ong yid kyi snang brnyan no/ /zhes lha la yid cung zad bzung nas/ spyi bo'i bla ma la mos pa rtse gcig du byas te/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ /bdag la rtse ba'i thugs kyis dgongs su gsol/ /las ngan sdig sgrib 'dag par byin gyi rlobs/ /tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /yang dag ting 'dzin skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyi rlobs/ /zhes snying thag pa nas gsol ba lan gsum la sogs pa btab la/ 'khor 'das bde sdug kun la khyab pa'i chos/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba rang gi sems/ /sems nyid rtags na kha dog dbyibs su med/ /med phyir gcig dang du ma'i ngo bos stong / /stong pa'i ngang gis skye 'gag gnas gsum bral/ /bral dang gsal stong snang 'gag spros kun zhi/

/zhi ba'i sems nyid mtha' bral chen po'o/ /zhes yid byed thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang la lhod de bzhag snying dbus pad zla'i steng du hrīḥyig mthar/ /yig drug sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rjes bskul nas bdag byin rlabs/ /'gro drug sems can rnams kyi don mdzad gyur/ /bar bsam la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes lnga brgya la sogs pa bzla ste/ thun 'jog pa na/ gdan rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsam/ dge ba 'di'i bdag sogs sems can rnams/ /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med dam chos ldan/ /phyi ma bde ba can gyi zhing skyes nas/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang go 'phang myur thob shog /lus ngag yid gsum lha sngags ye shes kyis/ /'khyer so gsum dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing / /snying rje'i dbang gis sems can don spyod cing / /rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa bsgrub par shog /'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs thams cad du/ /'dren mchog bla ma 'od dpag med mgon gyis/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus nam yang mi gtong bar/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa kun las skyob gyur gcig /ces sogs ci shes pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam btab/ dus thams cad du gnas khang bde ba can gyi zhing du bsam la/ rang spyan ras gzigs kyi nga rgyal gyis bla ma 'od dpag tu med pa'i zhabs 'bring ba byed par bsam zhing / sku gsung thugs kyi 'khyer so gsum dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas/ snying rje chen po'i sems can gyi don bsgrub pa la bslab par bya'o/ /thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug du nyams su blang ba zhes bya ba/ dpal sa skya pa yab sras kyi gdam pa 'di ni/ rang gi slob ma grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs tshigs su bcad par byas pa zhig dgos so/ /zhes rgyang ring mo nas bskul ba'i ngor/ btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis e waṃ chos ldan du shin tu myur bar bris nas mdo khams shar gyi phyogs su bskur ba'o/

/shu bhaṃ/ bkra shis// ༈ /thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'gro skyob yid 'ong snying rje chen po'i sku/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nyid sgrub thabs bla ma'i gsung bzhin du/ /gzhan la phan phyir bdag gi bshad par bya/ /de la 'dir las dang po pas jo bo chen po rje'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i bsgom bzlas byed par 'dod pas/ rang gnas su stan bde ba la dkyil krung la sogs pa'i spyod lam dang ldan pas/ thog mar skyabs 'gro bya ba ni/ bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung nas/ byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes bsam pa thag pa nas skyabs 'gro ci nus bya'o/ /de nas sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du jo bo thugs rje chen po bsgom par bya'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems skyed bsgom/ de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de nas/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bha wa shud+dha3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid hrī dkar po tsheg phrag dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba las/ thig le dkar po gsum du gyur te/ de yang dbus kyi che ba/ mtha' ma gnyis chung ba/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso 'khor gsum du gyur pa ni/ dbus su rang nyid thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba ltar kun nas dkar ba'i mdangs dang bcas pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ dbu skra phyed ral pa'i thor cog gyen du sgrengs pa la dar dkar po'i cod paṇa mdzad pa/

dbu skra phyed dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi steng na mar 'chang ba ni/ rlung gis skyod pa ltar bun ne yod pa'o/ /phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa mu tig gi 'phreng ba bsgrang zhing / g.yon gyi gnyis pas ut+pal dkar po snyan gyi thad kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dar sna tshogs kyis nam za can/ zhabs rdo rje dkyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su jo bo nor bu 'dzin pa sku mdog ser po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas rin po che dbang gi rgyal po yu ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas rin po che'i 'bras kyis snye ma bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na za'i mdzes pa/ dpus mo btsugs nas jo bo'i smin phrag du gzigs pa/ g.yon du jo mo 'bru drug pa sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas mu tig gi 'phreng ba bsgreng zhing / g.yon gyi gnyis pas ut+pal la 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar gyi na zas mdzes pa/ dpus mo btsugs shing / spyan gnyis jo bo'i thugs kar gzigs pa'o/ /gtso bo'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas jo bo gtso 'khor gsum pa mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ya a wa lo ki shwa ra sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha ye swa hā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe a hūm̐/ zhes sogs kyis mchod nas/ thal mo sbyar te/ ngag tu jo bo thugs rje chen pos bdag gi sems can thams cad kyi don du phya rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab pas/ mdun gyi lha gsum po spyi bor byon nas/ so so la thim par bsam mo/

/de nas gtso bo'i thugs kar hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes pas/ chos bskor du 'khor nas yod pa la dmigs nas bzlas pa byas pas/ sgra thams cad sems can gyi rna bar byung / lhang lhang sgrags pas/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa thams cad sangs dag par bsam zhing / ma ṇi pad+me ci nus bzlas so/ /'jug du sngar bzhin mchod nas/ skyon gyi ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /zhes sogs dang / gzhan yang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlabs du gsol/ /skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ /zhes sogs dang / byang chub sems ni rin po che/ /zhes sogs kyis smon lam rnam par dag pa btab/ thun mtshams thams cad du/ 'khor gnyis po rang la bsdus nas/ rang jo bo'i nga rgyal gyis sems can thams cad la snying rje bsgom pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi don ci nus bya'o/ /'di'i sems can mang po'i don byed par gyur gcig mkhas sgrub chen po'i dben sa dam pa bde ba can du bya bral dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba'o/ /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ /pha bla ma'i bsngo ba bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas skyabs su mchi'o/ /snying gtam rin chen tshig gsum ma brjed sems la zhog cig /skyes pa'i phyir na 'chi bas tshe 'di'i zhen pa chod cig /shi ba'i rjes su skye ba'i skye sa khyad par che'o/ /rang nyid mchog du bzung nas/ /khe dang rgyal kha bsgrubs nas/ /'og nas 'og du 'gro bas/ /thar pa'i go 'phangs med do/ /rtag tu dman cha bzung nas/ /gyong dang 'pham kha khur na/ /gong nas gong du 'gro ba'i/ /myur du thar pa thob bo/ /yar 'gro mar 'gro gnyis kyi/ /gyes mtshams chen mo'i dus 'dir/ /le lo'i bshan pa med do/ /ma nor lam la 'bungs shig /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor thob dus/ /bshes gnyen dam pa brten nas/ /lam zab nyams su len pa/ /bsod nams bsags pa lags so/

/nyams su len pa'i chos la/ /blo snying brang gsum gtod cig /gzhan gyi rnam rtog spongs la/ /sems dang chos su bsres shig /byang chub sems kyis zin pa'i/ /chos cig rgyud la skyes dang / /chos kun 'di ru 'du ba'i/ /byang chub sems mchog sgoms shig /'di phyi bar do gsum na/ /de'i slu ba med pa'i/ /don chen sgrub la yong gis/ /sems la phan par gyur cig /phyogs kyi bya bral sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis bsam gtan phug gi dben gnas su sems la phan phyir gsungs pa'i lan du/ gu ge bya bral bas phul bar/ /dgos 'dod yid bzhin nor bu/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i/ /thugs rje can gyis gzigs cig /shu bhuṃ/ maṅgalaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mngon rtogs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
